## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the change. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Implementation

Explain the main decisions, affected APIs and any compatibility or migration concerns.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. State which platforms or paths were not checked.
For extraction changes, include the fixture, expected records and report counters.
For performance claims, include the workload, machine, build profile and raw measurements.

## Documentation and release impact

- [ ] Public behavior and examples are documented, or this change has no documentation impact.
- [ ] Changed SDK names, types and examples agree with the implementation.
- [ ] Release notes distinguish source changes from published packages.
- [ ] Generated data, credentials and local build artifacts are excluded.

## Screenshots

For website changes, include the relevant desktop and narrow-screen view.
